questions.exactSourceOrConflict: All six rank9 identities have actual class17 access and26 base RP. Core supplies V,S,F and Action except Universal Time Stop Reaction; range120 ft except Eternal Prophecy Self. Core Instantaneous conflicts with sustained Time Stop benefits.
options: Preserve actual grants/costs/components and explicitly resolve each metadata conflict.
Change a printed cost, access or component only through an identified design departure.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use complete class engines and original placements. A special temporal benefit does not itself grant acquisition, free RP, a generic free Action or an unprinted consumed reagent. Countering/abandonment and Ready retain their actual scoped costs; all proposed exceptions must be named.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Illusion and Transmutation stop time for everyone but you for1d4+1 rounds using an Action. Universal grants3 uninterrupted turns using a Reaction whose trigger is unspecified.
options: Preserve source-qualified modes under one identity.
Select one reconciled procedure with an explicit account of every superseded source benefit.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer preserving both printed modes and exact acquisition routes until jointly decided. Do not average durations, silently drop a placement or treat all modes as freely acquired by every class. Define the missing Universal trigger and its priority before commitment.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Everyone but you versus Core120-ft range and Instantaneous; no concentration or affected-area geometry is stated.
options: Temporal interval affecting the whole relevant world while caster has personal progression.
Explicit bounded field with entry/exit rules, acknowledging the limitation on everyone.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve scope and functional duration explicitly. Identify creatures, unattended objects, environment and remote scenes. Do not silently convert everyone to one enemy or invent a spherical radius from range metadata; added concentration is NEW.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Rounds and turns are different events; granted uninterrupted turns must provide meaningful action opportunities.
options: Dedicated personal temporal turns with explicit budgets and ordinary-world pause.
Another exact schedule preserving the selected printed interval.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, movement and cast cadence on each granted turn; regular versus extra markers; Haste, once-per-numbered-round limits, recharge, death saves and pulse schedules. Grant the promised play opportunities without unprinted rest, RP or finite-use refresh. Reconcile each clock rather than calling all turns regular.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No printed prohibition on touching or attacking stopped creatures/objects; interruption-free does not specify payload delivery.
options: Permit interactions with explicit immediate/frozen/pending consequences.
Add a source-specific interaction boundary or early ending with stated loss of capability.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Make movement, doors, carried gear, attacks, spells, damage, conditions, projectiles and collision usable and ordered. An imported rule that attacks end Time Stop is NEW, not a known native restriction. Define frozen-body displacement and ownership without duplicating items or granting automatic critical hits.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Nesting, another temporal actor, Null/suppression and interruption are unspecified.
options: Single active interval with explicit admission/priority for later attempts.
Composable intervals with a deterministic ownership and clock model.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define counter opportunity before establishment, what uninterrupted excludes afterward, caster incapacity/death, concentration consequences if relevant, suppression/dispelling and exit. Do not create endless nested turns or let suppression replay the opening grant; retain paid costs and already completed actions.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Persistent damage/healing, falling, movement-entry events and concentration have real event clocks.
options: Classify each source clock as paused, caster-progressing or absolute with exact resume behavior.
Use another explicitly reviewed clock projection.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Give exact ordering for due events at opening/closing, no phantom regular START/END, and no duplicated payment/output. Existing temporal pulse adapters cover bounded references only; they do not decide Time Stop. Preserve actual Ready deadlines and source-specific ending costs under the selected clock policy.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Enemies reroll all d20s at disadvantage for1 minute;120-ft range states neither selection cap nor area.
options: A fixed eligible enemy roster acquired at resolution under explicit geometry.
A continuing area/aura with dynamic enemy membership under explicit geometry.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define hostility, perception/line of effect, number/area, allegiance changes and departure. Preserve plural enemies and all relevant d20s. Geometry/caps/initial saves are NEW; do not expose hidden allegiance simply to populate the UI.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Reroll ALL d20s at disadvantage could mean a complete forced replacement or merely ordinary disadvantage.
options: One mandatory replacement of each eligible complete d20 procedure, with a defined disadvantage state.
Ordinary disadvantage only, explicitly explaining departure from reroll.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer retaining an actual reroll. Specify the original event, replacement set, advantage cancellation, modifiers and final natural results. Only the final accepted roll resolves hit/save/task consequences; no original-result damage or recursive self-reroll.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share a scoped reroll-lineage guard and information windows; this spell is not yet within that whitelist.
options: Extend a named finite lineage contract to this mandatory replacement with explicit precedence.
Specify a separate finite interaction model with those sources and fixed-roll effects.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Decide forced versus optional replacement ordering, already-replaced rolls, substituted fixed results, opposed/shared rolls and secret RNG. Never grant an optional caster decision after seeing protected rolls. Initiative, death saves and other d20 categories need explicit inclusion/exclusion rather than an unexplained attack-only implementation.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: No save, concentration or named condition is printed; existing hard-denial and divination-information defenses have limited scope.
options: Automatic nonconcentration ongoing roll modifier, with only genuinely applicable protections.
Add a precisely stated resistance/concentration rule as NEW authorship.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not equate Divination school with information-only scrying or impose Charmed immunity on unrelated probability manipulation. Determine whether any selected consequence actually meets hard-denial criteria; never spend/refund a hard-denial allowance merely from the spell name.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: One-minute endpoint must survive suppression, replacement, initiative transitions and target changes.
options: Source-owned original endpoint and explicit same/different caster overlap.
Another named lifecycle matching the full printed minute.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Classify one parent and target children, cast origin, removal and suppressed versus ended state. Resolve a roll whose replacement window crosses expiry once; no retroactive changes to an already committed result or duration refresh from suppression.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Printed YOU cannot be surprised/critically hit for1 hour; Core range120 feet.
options: Self only, preserving120-ft metadata as superseded conflict evidence.
One chosen recipient within120 feet, explicitly expanding the printed you.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Prefer Self absent new delegation; compare Foresight Flicker and Momentary Pause as precedents, not automatic authority for this spell. Preserve all three full benefits for the selected legal recipient.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Cannot be surprised or critically hit, not cannot be hit or cannot suffer any severe consequence.
options: Prevent surprise and downgrade otherwise critical hits through the native attack pipeline.
Another explicit procedure preserving both printed protections.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify initiative already determined versus future surprise; natural20/expanded critical threats, attack riders, Wounds and ordinary damage. Do not negate a normal hit, all Wounds, crafting degrees or an unrelated critical result; no automatic detection of hidden enemies.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Advantage on ALL saves for the same hour.
options: All actual saving throws use ordinary advantage/disadvantage combination.
Explicitly narrower saving-throw categories as a design departure.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Retain the full category including source-qualified death/condition saves when those procedures are actual saves. No auto-success, second save entitlement, changed DC, hidden information or task-check advantage. Resolve simultaneous Time Fracture under the selected finite lineage contract.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: One-hour duration; no concentration, consumed trigger or once-only wording.
options: Ongoing nonconcentration benefits until original endpoint with scoped suppression/replacement.
Added concentration or other ending trigger explicitly NEW.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not consume after one prevented critical/surprise or one save. Define death/revival and same/different caster overlays; suspension does not restart the hour and expiry removes only this source contribution.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Change ONE past EVENT within the last24 hours; scope of event and knowledge prerequisites absent.
options: One identifiable causal event with explicit admissible alternative and bounded consequence closure.
Another finite event-selection grammar delivering a real past change.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define event granularity, actual observation/knowledge, alternative input and boundary inclusion at24h. Do not substitute a future reroll, cosmetic memory edit or ordinary healing. Reject vague global narratives through a usable declaration procedure before payment, not an always-unavailable positive spell.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A real past change may alter downstream actions, deaths, transfers and knowledge.
options: Recompute/reconcile a specified causal descendant set into one current history.
Replace one event with explicitly bounded retained downstream facts.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: List which consequences follow and which are conserved, including third-party dependencies. Explain any bounded departure from the promise. No duplicate people, unique items or rewards; no branch may both retain a paid object and undo its payment without a deliberate rule.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core120-ft targeting does not say whether it refers to the old event site, current participants or another anchor.
options: Current perceived participant/event anchor within120 ft.
Historical site or another explicit source-qualified target.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select an exact range/line/plane criterion and show a positive event that can be rewritten. Knowledge cannot be fabricated by the declaration UI. Range does not silently become a120-ft spherical history-erasure radius.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Original casting cost, memory and absolute elapsed time are not defined by changing an event.
options: Conserve current caster payment and protected economy/history with an explicit memory policy.
Another stated temporal accounting policy subject to duplication/paradox checks.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify normal HP versus temp HP versus healing assignment, current inventory/custody, RP/rest uses/cadence, quest/reward receipts, clocks, body/identity and each witness memory. Keep engine audit history distinct from character knowledge; no recursive refund of the rewrite itself.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Changing a lethal event may conflict with actual death-instance, Hunt and soul/cosmology authority.
options: Undo an admissible event under explicit death/identity eligibility and owner locks.
Leave the exact cosmology-sensitive death case held while authoring positive non-death changes.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Identify the genuine conflict without inventing resurrection permission, a new soul copy or a deity ruling. Distinguish prevention by altered history from ordinary revival, but do not use that distinction to evade explicit final-death authority. Preserve complete original lore and current owner corrections.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: The Oracle Time Loop reference restores initiative-start state in a bounded fixture; it is not a24-hour event editor.
options: Define a distinct rewrite transaction with explicit reusable temporal interfaces and missing adapters.
Extend the existing architecture only through named reviewed new contracts.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep Time Loop unavailable until its own gates close. Do not import its once-long-rest/round-four eligibility into Fate Rewrite or mistake transport/history checks for full spell implementation. Specify nested rewrite, earlier rewritten events and conflicts with pending prophecy.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Force ENTIRE battlefield into alternate FUTURE; Core120 ft/Instantaneous/Action, Director (GM in Core) determines outcome.
options: One battlefield scope with a finite future horizon and legal outcome envelope.
Another deterministic declaration/outcome mechanism preserving the whole battlefield transformation.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define battlefield boundary/participants/objects, caster inclusion, off-map dependencies and horizon. Preserve a substantial alternate future, not one debuff or a handful of teleports. Any cap/selection restriction is NEW; no new plane or parallel-universe cosmology follows from alternate.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Director determines outcome in a computer RPG; exact authority and player information are unspecified.
options: Authored Director policies plus deterministic state validation and seeded choice.
Another explicit outcome selection interface with real authored alternatives.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify what caster chooses, what Director chooses and what is previewed before commitment. A live LLM is not implicitly required. Give feasible, replayable outcomes with bounded data and explain meaningful benefits/risks; do not replace selection with arbitrary unavailable status.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Advancing a battlefield to an alternate future affects costs, injuries, actions, objects and external actors.
options: One atomic proposed future with full conservation/provenance reconciliation.
Another exact event/state transaction preserving single-world identity.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define simulated actions and their legal resources, actual damage/healing/Wounds/deaths, persistent sources, concentration and item custody. No free reward farming, invented creature stats or silent auto-success of all attacks. Preflight external dependencies and stale world changes before commitment; distinguish failed commitment from paid interrupted casting.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Instantaneous outcome does not define whether ordinary-world time advances or continuing sources age.
options: Explicit world-time advancement with due-event processing.
Present-time replacement by a possible future state with conserved clocks.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose and label the new temporal policy. Reconcile source deadlines, jobs/rests, suppression, dispelling, Ready and nested Time Stop/Time Loop. Once an actual instantaneous change commits, later Null is not automatically a complete rollback of physical history.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Create a SELF-FULFILLING prophecy that MUST COME TRUE within1YEAR; Self range and Instantaneous.
options: A finite admissible proposition with objective success predicate and explicit fulfillment mechanism.
Another authored prophecy grammar preserving a guaranteed outcome.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define participants, event, scope, maximum horizon and what makes a declaration admissible. A vague omen, advice or mere probability bonus does not satisfy must come true. No present omniscience or fabricated statement that an unplayed future event already happened.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: A guaranteed future requires a mechanism when later voluntary actions or obstacles would defeat it.
options: A committed causal plan with legal alternative routes and deterministic fulfillment obligations.
Explicit bounded direct fate intervention with named limits and costs.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify what the engine can change, when, and how it ensures completion before the deadline. Show at least one nontrivial positive fulfillment across saved campaign progression. Preserve agency where promised; if a necessary compulsion or new resource generation is authorized, label it rather than hiding it in narration.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Impossible, contradictory, recursive or mutually exclusive prophecies are not resolved in source.
options: Precommit admissibility/compatibility checks with an explicit priority system for live obligations.
Another exact conflict resolution preserving already committed guarantees.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Address already-true claims, caster death, third-party agency, unique artifacts, Hunt/soul constraints and future rewriting. Do not silently break an earlier guarantee, acquire infinite resources, or turn contradictions into unknown cosmology facts. State what the player can know without revealing protected secrets.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: One-year deadline and Instantaneous origin do not specify ongoing magical parent, suppression or dispelling.
options: Instantaneous creation of a persistent fate obligation with explicit intervention/suppression rules.
An ongoing magical parent with exact endpoint and explicit resolution of Instantaneous conflict.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define the campaign calendar year, original deadline, cross-plane clock and completed/failed/ended states. No fixed cosmological Cycle age is inferred. Specify which component can be suppressed/dispelled and whether fulfillment is delayed, transferred or cancelled; cancellation would qualify the printed guarantee and requires decision.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Past changes, alternate futures and a guaranteed prophecy can target the same causal history.
options: Shared source-ID obligation registry with explicit compatible outcomes and conflict priority.
Another finite arbitration contract scoped to these three spells.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve replacing the prophecy creation event, choosing a future where a live guarantee cannot occur, and overlapping rewrites. Preserve one canonical history, audit provenance and genuine paid costs. A missing implementation adapter remains a named engineering hold, not a retrospective design nerf.

questions.exactSourceOrConflict: Persistent temporal effects must survive save/load and three-mode play; full Time Loop is not implemented and pending conferences are not accepted authority.
options: Serializable source/clock/lineage records with deterministic event contracts and separate implementation gates.
Another explicit persistence model with equivalent reconstruction evidence.
questions.recommendationAndConsequences: Return complete useful authored procedures and source-qualified positive and adverse examples, preserving all8 placements and actual access. Bind the original inputs and identify each selected NEW completion. Separate source preservation, semantic acceptance, engine tests, human play, balance, cosmology and release; no canonical application under the owner reservation.

futureCaseRequirements.requirements: For each actual acquired mode use real class17+ grant, present RP/strain/cadence and V,S,F; show permitted casting, commitment, counter and interrupted failure. No assumed class permission merely from level or26RP. Include source-specific Ready only when legitimately reachable.

Exercise every selected source mode using explicit1d4 result for1d4+1 and all3 Universal turns if preserved. Show actual trigger, preceding atomic event, per-turn budgets, legal actions/movement, suspended actors and exact resumption without invented regular markers or finite-resource refill.

Show a meaningful interaction with a frozen creature/object, an existing Haste/Ready or pulse source, suppression/ending and one nesting conflict. Track damage/condition consequences, geometry, ownership, both clocks and exactly-once costs; do not use only rejected casts as positive evidence.

One coherent encounter includes at least two eligible enemies, original/replacement d20 values, natural results, advantage cancellation, a permitted optional reroll interaction, secret roll and a save. Show final-only consequence, continuing minute, changed membership if applicable and expiry/suppression. Use actual source-qualified combat values.

Show real surprise prevention, one critical reduced through the native hit procedure, normal hit damage/riders retained, at least two actual saves including an advantage/disadvantage combination, and the original hour endpoint. No invented immunity or hidden-enemy revelation.

One nontrivial actual event with timestamp inside24h, legitimate known anchor, concrete alternative, complete causal before/after participants/inventory/resources/memories/world time and one current legal history. Preserve caster payment and source identity; success must truly change the past event.

Boundary at24h, too-old/unknown/ambiguous event, harvested/transferred unique material, existing death/Hunt issue and prior rewrite. Distinguish selected rule results from narrow unresolved content/cosmology gates; never fabricate missing identity or revive the same body twice.

Entire concrete battlefield with actual participants and environment enters a valid Director-selected future. Show declaration choices, future horizon, legal simulated costs/actions, injuries and continued effects, outsiders/custody and final time. Include incompatible external dependency and stale preflight without partial writes.

Trace two different causal paths, obstruction and save/load before eventual guaranteed fulfillment. State actual engineering prerequisites; authored future trace is not proof a year of human gameplay occurred.
